answer_1.quote: We propose a novel hybrid LLM and graph-based method to extract dialogue policies ... The extracted policies can be expressed as sequences of user and assistant canonical forms ...
answer_1.outputs: Dialogue policies expressed as sequences of canonical forms (user and bot intents)

answer_2.quote: We use standard text generation metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, and BERTSCORE) to assess the dialogue flow coverage and quality. We also compute Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) and precision/recall of canonical forms.

answer_4.quote: For manual evaluation, we use 8 annotators... The annotators are asked to map the canonical forms in the dialogue flow to the corresponding conversation turn, as well as assign a score to the canonical form (4.3).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators map each canonical form to a conversation turn and rate its relevance (score 1 for fully covered, 0.5 for partially covered).
